raw.title: Add Membrane API Gateway
raw.body:
Adds **Membrane API Gateway** as a manual entry in `src/_data/tools.yaml`.

- Homepage: https://www.membrane-api.io
- Repository: https://github.com/membrane/api-gateway
- Language: Java
- Categories: Gateway, Data Validators, Server Implementations
- OpenAPI support: 2.0, 3.0, 3.1, and 3.2 (3.2 noted in the description text, since there is no dedicated column)

Open source API gateway with built-in OpenAPI support — turns OpenAPI descriptions into APIs and enforces request/response validation.
